review_method: Inspect code paths and named positive/negative assertions against each invariant, exact source provenance and declared platform evidence.
procedure: Run focused Windows credential suites, complete pytest regression on Windows and Linux, required isolated Linux SSH gate, actual both-role packaging/installer workflows, then inspect exact-source logs, owner booleans, negative assertions and immutable history. Exact run/job IDs and counts in reviewed-validation.md.
expected: Actual Windows user/session/logon, owner/DACL, held file identity/content version, local volume and fixed-purpose/target checks gate use without elevation.
observed: Final Windows native15 PASS, hosted owner diagnostic false/true; local focused86 PASS. CI1790/17skip/4xfail, Linux Desktop1801/15skip/4xfail and Windows Desktop1777/39skip/4xfail PASS; both-role bundle/GUI/install/uninstall/profile preservation PASS on both platforms. Progress172 tests/ledger/history/scanner PASS; invariant and privacy/rollback review accepted with stated limits.
platform_scope: Windows10+ x64 local and hosted native APIs; Ubuntu22.04 Desktop plus Ubuntu CI. Synthetic files only; platform-specific skips retained.
negative_cases: Missing/exclusively locked provider; broad or NULL DACL; wrong owner/user/session/logon; thread impersonation.
Unavailable interactive session, missing or changed target trust, denied or arbitrary purpose, expired or revoked selection.
Changed content even with restored timestamp; replaced/missing/empty/oversized file; multiple hard links; device/UNC/relative/stream/path aliases.
Permission, identity, expiry, revocation and version changes after an earlier READY observation or while acquiring the held key.
Closed exception and malformed/raw callback results; one attempted fixed call with UNKNOWN and no automatic retry after lost acknowledgement.
Opaque references, hidden private repr and closed capability reports exclude synthetic canary, path, SID, target and material.
Rotation/revocation preserve selected and unrelated synthetic key files; no installer credential import or deletion.
Explicit synthetic file ownership under differing hosted/local defaults; production exact-owner validation stays unchanged.
Journal capitalization correction rejects renames/collisions/mixed/duplicate/future malformed rows and preserves original outcomes and bytes.
Existing cancellation-race and supervision defects remain four strict expected failures; they are not claimed fixed by RP020.
unverified_scope: No deployed enrollment, protected durable bindings, real endpoint authentication/fixed SSH helper integration, live migration, encrypted key parsing or native key-use selftest inside the bundle. These remain later commissioning/transport/platform gates.
rollback: Revoke/remove only new process-local references; preserve selected and unrelated external key files, profiles and existing runtime.
